howToExport: Open N26 in a web browser; the CSV download is offered in the web app.
Select the account or Space, open Downloads and, under account activity, set the date range.
Choose CSV, download the file and drop it above.
knownQuirks: N26 exports carry two dates, Booking Date and Value Date, and YNAB needs one. The preset uses the booking date, the day the transaction hit your account.
The counterparty is in Partner Name (Payee in older exports) and the purpose in Payment Reference; YNAB keeps them apart as Payee and Memo.
Card payments abroad are already converted to EUR, with the original amount and currency in separate columns; only the EUR amount is imported.
Header names and decimal style vary with the export version and language (English or German names, dot or comma); both are recognised.

columnMapping.transformationNote: Split into positive Outflow and Inflow
